design: Capture all18 layers: block input, x0, attention output, normalized MLP input, MLP output, block output at last token. Exact factorial coefficients and learned-scale residual recurrence. Trace contributions to raw pre-MLP12 interaction by multiplying each earlier attention/MLP write by subsequent residual scales.
limits: Frozen native trajectory additive attribution, not intervention mediation; downstream writes are held at their observed values for bookkeeping and would change under interventions. Attention writes can transport interactions formed at earlier token positions. Final-token alignment is functional, not equal absolute position. Raw normalized-input interactions include normalization effects.
selection: Rank signed projection contribution to raw pre-MLP12 interaction on familiar original-format competent quartets. Other cohorts diagnostic; no tuning on original reserved test.
next: Use dominant upstream attention/MLP site for finite intervention and token-position tracing, rather than interpreting output norm alone as importance.
